description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16 by ADA during Arc 26 build (stoa--dxw).** the-stoa is itself a substrate-deployed workspace (has its own .claude/ with role files + skills), but its own absolute path is NOT in substrate/consumer-workspaces.txt. Result: `check.sh` no-args sweep skips it; drift in the-stoa's own .claude/ goes unnoticed unless someone explicitly runs `check.sh --workspace .` from the repo root.

## The fix

Append `/c/Users/denso/claude_projects/the-stoa` (the canonical clone path per stoa--i6c reminder) to substrate/consumer-workspaces.txt. Verify check.sh picks it up + correctly reports CURRENT or DRIFTED for it (the self-referential case has been working in --workspace mode per ADA's Phase 2 smoke; it just isn't in the auto-swept registry).

## Why P4

Easy to miss when the-stoa drifts from itself (e.g., manual edits to .claude/MAJOR_*.md that don't get rolled back via substrate-update apply). Fix-now is cheap; defer cost compounds.

## Cross-refs

- stoa--dxw — Arc 26 ticket (where ADA surfaced this)
- stoa--i6c — local clone path reminder
- substrate/consumer-workspaces.txt — the registry file
title: Arc 26 follow-up: the-stoa's own .claude/ absent from consumer-workspaces registry
